             object() | Combinable()
+
+    def test_order_by_multiline_sql(self):
+        # Test that multiline RawSQL in order_by doesn't get deduplicated incorrectly
+        # See https://code.djangoproject.com/ticket/...
+        qs = Company.objects.all().order_by(
+            RawSQL('''
+                case when name = 'Example Inc.'
+                     then 2 else 1 end''', []).desc(),
+            RawSQL('''
+                case when name = 'Example Inc.'
+                     then 1 else 0 end''', []).asc(),
+        )
+        # The query should have both order by clauses, not just one
+        compiler = qs.query.get_compiler(qs.db)
+        order_by = compiler.get_order_by()
+        # Should have 2 order by expressions
+        self.assertEqual(len(order_by), 2)
